object.attr: stakeholder: a rule picks objects by attribute value. Values compare as text, so 1.0 doesn't match 1; whether that is wanted is a question. An attribute that isn't set has no value, so it matches no value (review Q13).
object.description: Mellon shall match an object to a name in a rule condition, other than has-outgoing-link and requirement-type, if and only if the object's attribute of that name has exactly the given value.
